### Demo 5 — NetworkPolicy isolation, with a control
-- policies in force:
NAME                               MATCHLABELS         MATCHEXPR                                                           TYPES
allow-alb-to-frontend              map[app:frontend]   <none>                                                              [Ingress]
allow-aws-api-egress               <none>              [map[key:app operator:In values:[worker backup]]]                   [Egress]
allow-canary-egress                map[app:canary]     <none>                                                              [Egress]
allow-db-egress                    <none>              [map[key:app operator:In values:[backend worker backup migrate]]]   [Egress]
allow-dns-egress                   <none>              <none>                                                              [Egress]
allow-frontend-to-backend          map[app:backend]    <none>                                                              [Ingress]
allow-frontend-to-backend-egress   map[app:frontend]   <none>                                                              [Egress]
allow-prometheus-scrape            <none>              [map[key:app operator:In values:[backend worker frontend]]]         [Ingress]
default-deny                       <none>              <none>                                                              [Ingress Egress]
-- egress rules, per policy (who may reach what, on which port):
allow-aws-api-egress
    -> 0.0.0.0/0   ports: TCP/443 
allow-canary-egress
    -> 0.0.0.0/0   ports: TCP/443 
allow-db-egress
    -> 10.0.0.0/16   ports: TCP/5432 
allow-dns-egress
    ->   ports: UDP/53 TCP/53 
allow-frontend-to-backend-egress
    -> 172.20.0.0/16 10.0.0.0/16   ports: TCP/5000 
-- worker pod age (must be > ~2m for this probe to mean anything):
NAME                      AGE
worker-84c8b8c46b-7rfxk   2026-08-23T10:20:05Z
-- real probe: worker -> backend:5000 (must NOT connect):
   BLOCKED by NetworkPolicy: TimeoutError
-- control: worker -> RDS:5432 (must connect — allow-db-egress permits it):
   RDS REACHABLE (the probe works)

### Demo 5b — the FRONTEND cannot reach the database (Task 3 review T3-1)
-- resolved RDS host from the ConfigMap: voteball-eks-db.cfew0a2ywspq.il-central-1.rds.amazonaws.com
-- control A: backend -> RDS:5432 on that host (must connect):
   RDS REACHABLE from backend (host correct, RDS up)
-- control B: frontend -> backend:5000 (must connect — allow-frontend-to-backend-egress permits it):
   BACKEND REACHABLE (nc works in this image)
-- real probe: frontend -> RDS:5432, same host as control A (must NOT connect):
   BLOCKED — the frontend has no route to the database
